source_prompts.kitchen: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate one original fictional candid lifestyle photograph, portrait 3:4, for a Plog product demonstration. Exactly three fictional East Asian adults in their late twenties gathered at a plain kitchen table making dumplings together. Person on left, woman in faded navy shirt, looking toward the person at right with an amused smile, holding one unusually lopsided handmade dumpling palm-up. Person on right, man in oatmeal shirt, returning her glance with a playful grin, hands visible near the table. Third person centered slightly behind, woman in dusty rose shirt, laughing at the exchange, hands resting clearly and naturally on the table edge. Warm ordinary home kitchen, pale uncluttered plaster wall above their heads, a few plain ceramic bowls, flour, dough and a modest wooden tray of dumplings below. Upper 30 percent naturally blank wall; all three faces large enough to read and all hands unambiguous. Natural soft daylight, true skin tones, documentary family snapshot, realistic anatomically coherent hands and arms. The shared dumpling and exchanged glances visibly connect the group. No text, graphics, logos, watermarks, brands, celebrity likeness, copyrighted character or collage. Do not imitate an existing artist or photograph.
